configurations.name: api
runtimeArgs: php artisan optimize:clear && php artisan optimize && php artisan serve --port=9191

$comment_prefect_server: prefect-server is OPT-IN and is deliberately NOT started by run-all.sh. Orchestration has no long-running server of its own; this entry exists only for local flow development (onboard Step 7.5). It binds :4200 — the single port orchestration can contend for. Omit this configuration entirely if Orchestration was not selected. The PREFECT_PROFILE=local prefix is required: without it the server inherits whatever profile is globally active, which may be frndos_prefect (staging AND production).
